title: Constrict
summary: CONSTRICT, verb transitive [Latin See Constrain.] To draw together; to bind; to cramp; to draw into a narrow compass; hence, to contract or cause to shrink.

inlines.v: CONSTRICT, verb transitive [Latin See Constrain.] To draw together; to bind; to cramp; to draw into a narrow compass; hence, to contract or cause to shrink.
